title: Continuum Backup & Recovery Service Description — Backup Protection Features by Tier
content:
The protection a Continuum Backup & Recovery plan delivers day to day is set by its tier: how often protected servers are backed up, how long restore points are kept, which safeguards are part of the service, how quickly a failed backup is taken up by a technician, and how often the client receives a backup success report.

## Backup schedule, retention and reporting

| Tier | Interval between scheduled server backups (minutes) | Restore points retained (days) | Failed backup to technician remediation start (minutes) | Backup success report cadence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 1440 | 30 | 1440 | monthly |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 720 | 90 | 720 | monthly |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 240 | 365 | 240 | weekly |
| Continuum BDR | 60 | 365 | 240 | weekly |
| Continuum DRaaS | 60 | 2190 | 60 | daily |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 15 | 2555 | 30 | daily |

For orientation only: 1440 minutes is once a day and 720 minutes is twice a day; 2190 days and 2555 days are six and seven years of 365 days.

## Safeguards included

| Tier | Immutable cloud copy kept | On-site backup appliance supplied | Backup-stream anomaly detection | Failed backups triaged around the clock |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | No | No | No | No |
| Continuum Backup Standard | Yes | No | No | No |
| Continuum Backup Plus | Yes | No | Yes | No |
| Continuum BDR | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Continuum DRaaS | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Definitions

- **Backup interval** — the time between scheduled server backups, in whole minutes.
- **Retention** — the number of days restore points are retained.
- **Immutable cloud copy** — whether an immutable cloud copy is kept.
- **On-site appliance** — whether an on-site backup appliance is supplied.
- **Anomaly detection** — whether backup-stream anomaly detection is included.
- **Around-the-clock triage** — whether failed backups are triaged around the clock.
- **Remediation start** — the time from a failed scheduled backup to the start of technician remediation, in whole minutes.
- **Report cadence** — how often a backup success report is issued: monthly, weekly or daily.

## Reading across tiers

A tier lower on the ladder never has a shorter backup interval, a longer retention or a faster remediation start than the tier above it; Continuum BDR and Continuum DRaaS share the same 60-minute interval, and Continuum Backup Plus and Continuum BDR share both the 365-day retention and the 240-minute remediation start.
